## Checklist

- [ ] `pnpm typecheck` passes
- [ ] `pnpm test` passes
- [ ] `pnpm build` passes
- [ ] New behavior is behind a `brand.features.*` flag if it could surprise existing shops (default **off**)
- [ ] No credentials or `.env*` content in the diff
- [ ] Docs updated where behavior changed (README / `docs/`)
